title: repo-wiki pages still document the deleted tk herd commands
description:
Discovered by the pwp deletion epic (worker on tick gms, attempt 8) while updating skills/ticks docs.

The repo wiki still carries pages describing the tk herd command family that pwp deleted: herd-helper-cli.md and others. A reader following the wiki will try commands that no longer exist.

Scope: sweep the wiki pages for references to tk herd spawn/wait/collect/reconcile/cleanup/notify/paint/watch/plugin and either delete the page or rewrite it to point at ticfac, matching what gms did for skills/ticks.

Verification: grep the wiki source for 'tk herd' returns no hits describing live commands.
acceptance_criteria: No repo-wiki page documents a tk herd subcommand as a live command; a grep for 'tk herd' across the wiki source returns only historical references explicitly marked as removed
